state:
**Goal `ext-image-analysis` — `Novis\Image` compares, hashes, summarises and draws. Stage 2, comparison, and stage 3's hashing are on disk; placeholders, palette and Stages 4 to 5 are not.**

The design is ADR 0120 §§ 8 and 9, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets, the crates included. No session re-decides one.

Comparison and hashing: the component's `compare` and `hash` exports (`extensions/image/src/compare.rs`, `extensions/image/src/hash.rs`, whose module docs define them), the manifest's `Codec::compare` and `Codec::hash` and `HashKind`, `Image::compare`, `Diff`, `Image::hash` and `Image::hashDistance` (`extensions/image/nvs/`), the host checks in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs` and the two `image-compare-*` / `image-hash-*` cases under `tests/conformance/novis/`. `rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`'s *Not shipped* paragraph says what is on disk. The three hashes are written in the component with no crate: `image_hasher` was the goal writer's unconfirmed pick, and a few dozen lines of grid and DCT keep a third-party crate out of the guest.

The goal record's stage 2 and 3 checks were repointed at the tests the tree holds: `nvs-ext` cannot run Novis source, so the record's claims about `hashDistance` and "runs each `Image` argument once" are not host tests. `hashDistance` is pinned by `tests/conformance/novis/image-hash-distance-finds-a-near-duplicate.nvst`; the once-per-`Image` claim has no harness that counts crossings from Novis (backlog).

The component's own unit tests run with `cargo test --lib` inside `extensions/image/`, a workspace of its own.

items.text: **The `placeholder` and `palette` exports** (`rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`, ADR 0120 § 8) — wired in at `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:677` and `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:681`: `BlurHash` and `ThumbHash` through the `blurhash` and `thumbhash` crates (each checked with `cargo deny` and the third-party notice) or written in the component; `palette` through `color_quant`, already linked, most frequent first and at most `count`. Follow `hash.rs`'s split of a core function over `Pixels` with host unit tests.

**`Image::placeholder`, `Image::palette`, `PlaceholderKind`** — `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:329`, after `hashDistance`, and entries after `hash` at `extensions/image/manifest.json:43`; `palette` returns `array<Color>` with `count = 5`.

**The placeholder and palette checks** — `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs:314`: the four names of the record's `nvs-ext-placeholders-and-palette` check, then `tests/conformance/novis/image-placeholder-and-palette-of-a-plain-image.nvst`.

backlog: "`compare` runs each `Image` argument once" has no test: no harness runs Novis and reads `nvs_ext::call::Request::crossings`. It wants one in whichever crate runs `Novis\Image` with the host (`crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs` places the builder).
Pre-existing comment bounds in `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs` (lines 55, 118, 158, 358) fail `bun nv proofs --comments`; stage 6's proofs will meet them.
Stages 4 (QR codes) and 5 (text), then stage 6's feature proofs for every member this goal adds.
